label: baseline-v0
name: Baseline v0
change: original pipeline: dense search only (multilingual-e5-small, pgvector HNSW)

label: baseline-v0-cache
name: Embedder cache
change: + embedding model loaded once instead of per question (retrieval only, not judged; still approximate HNSW search)

label: baseline-v1
name: Baseline v1
change: + exact vector search per index (the shared HNSW index made recall depend on what else was in the database); answers generated from the top 5 and judged on full chunks (official baseline)

label: hybrid-v1
name: Hybrid search
change: + BM25 keyword search in PostgreSQL, fused with dense results (RRF)

label: rerank-v1
name: Re-ranking
change: + cross-encoder bge-reranker-v2-m3 on the fused candidates
